description:
Creates a shareable link to a playground that runs the given code in the browser (PHP in WebAssembly), with no
account and nothing to install. Give only the files you change or add: the others stay as in the starting
project (see get_starter). Nothing is stored: the code travels inside the link, after the "#". The page asks
the visitor before running code received by a link.

files.description: The files to change or add, by path relative to the project root (e.g. "src/Controller/AccueilController.php"), with their full content.

language.description: Language of the page: "fr" for a French-speaking user, else "en".

packages.description: Symfony and plain PHP playgrounds: Composer packages to add, from the "packages" list of get_starter (e.g. "symfony/security-bundle", "nesbot/carbon"). For Symfony, their Flex recipe is applied when the page opens.

name: create_sandbox
title: Create a shareable PHP playground
